notes.title: NodeWebkit 0.25 and other updates
notes.notes:
There is an update coming on October 4th that will update NodeWebkit and hopefully stop the "Expired Profile" errors you folks have been getting. Unfortunately, this will also clear all of you progress. If you're willing to suffer through the error and play the game as it is, you have until 10/4 at midnight eastern before the new update goes live to complete it with your current progress.

There's approx an hour and a half of content, so it should be doable in one sitting.

Sorry for the inconvenience! 

We will be doing another update that will clear saves again, but not until mid or late October and you will get at least a week's notice.

-Fisher

notes.title: In regards to Mac and Linux/SteamOS users....
notes.notes:
Good news! Mac and Linux/SteamOS ports will be available on Steam eventually. Unfortunately, they will not be available from Steam at launch. There are some performance issues to be ironed out on the Mac port and I haven't actually gotten a chance to test the linux build at all... 

You will be able to get them on our itch.io page on launch day for $2.00 as part of early access. This way you can notify me of a bug ahead of time and help make the move to Steam easier! ːsteamhappyː

[url=smugames.itch.io/brkout-beta]You can find the early access itch.io page here![/url]

I expect the OS X port to become available a couple weeks after launch, so early to mid October. The Linux/SteamOS one should follow shortly afterwards assuming I can get an acceptable testing environment in the next few weeks.

Thanks for your patience! I hope to see you again at launch or in October.

-Fisher
